deviations: 1) Colour bindings. Ink text (The, collection, Name 1-3) is bound to color/text/primary, not color/bg/inverse as the section 3.6 table says. Both are #1f1c18, and text/primary is the text token. Terracotta is bound to color/accent/default (Kicker letters, Kiln, Pointer, Terracotta circle). Stone prices are bound to color/text/secondary, the Cream circle to color/bg/page and S3/BG to color/bg/subtle. S3/Window keeps raw #e8e2da, which has no variable. 2) Letter spacing: -1% is written as -1.2 px on S3/The and S3/collection. At 120 px this renders the same. 3) The photos are new rectangles filled by imageHash with scaleMode FILL (#11 Mug, #13 Plates, #12 Bowl), not clones. 4) Measured widths: wThe 173, wKiln 188, wColl 451. That gives S3/The-mask 185x144 at (58,452), S3/Kiln-mask 236x144 at (243,452) and S3/collection-mask 463x144 at (58,572). 'Dinner Plates' measures 320 px, which is 376 or less, so all three names stay at 60 px. Everything else follows D.4 exactly: 42 nodes in the specified z-order, LAYER_BLUR radius 0 on S3/Content, S3/Cream circle and S3/Terracotta circle, Window radii [260,260,0,0], and a fixed 600x34 S3/Kicker row with spacing 6 and alignment MIN/MIN. Keyframes for all 19 animated layers were copied from final-spec.keyframes.json and sent in one figma_batch, with timelineDuration 14.4 on the first step: 34 tracks, 115 keys. figma_get_motion_context read back every track identically on timeline 42:15160, 14.4 s.
problems: 1) Tool bug: move_nodes inside figma_batch reported ok:true but did not move S3/Kiln-mask, which stayed at x 260. A standalone figma_move_nodes call fixed it, and it now reads x 243. 2) Keyframing writes each node's t=0 opacity into its base opacity. The container, Plates, Bowl, Pointer and both circles now read opacity 0, so figma_export_node of anything inside S3 returns 1x1 (the rendering trap in the inventory). The only resting still, build/s3-content-rest.png (with s3-mug-plates-rest.png for the Mug and Plates crops), was taken before keyframing. That still shows the Kiln-mask at its old x 260, so the gap between 'The' and 'Kiln' is 17 px too wide in it. The fixed position (Kiln glyph box at screen x 267 = 64+173+30) is checked only from node geometry. 3) After keyframing, Figma reports twin ids, e.g. S3/Content 42:15263 is also 42:15268 and the frame is also 42:15160. Both id sets are in build/s3-ids.json. 4) figma_check_layout on the container: 2 errors and 5 warnings, all by design. The 144 px line boxes of S3/The and S3/Kiln overlap S3/collection's box by 24 px (lines 120 apart; the glyphs do not touch). The photos are clipped by the arch window and the 3000 px bloom circles extend past the container. Fonts are only Cormorant Garamond (6 nodes) and Inter (13 nodes), with no fallbacks. 5) Not verifiable without a render: whether S3/Kicker's STACK_SPACING reflows. The TRANSLATION_X fallback is in D.4 if the verification render shows no change. No video was rendered, and nothing outside 42:15042 was touched.
